meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (1MA1/3F, Monday 10 June 2024, P76926A), downloaded from qualifications.pearson.com. Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks, mark-scheme codes and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: All 29 (Total for Question) lines recovered and summing to the printed 80. Coded WITH mark_split.

coding_notes: q3 (value of a digit in a whole number) tagged decimals, the documented handling for place value.

q6a and q6b (map scale both ways) tagged ratio then converting_measurements, the ordering the coding doc names for map-scale items. q6b additionally has to choose its own units, which is why it carries a second process mark.
q8 (will there be an election in a stated year) tagged factors_and_multiples: every mark-scheme route is building or testing a multiple sequence from a start year.
q25 tagged growth_and_decay — this one IS compound, unlike 2F q15's simple interest, and the mark scheme's middle process mark is explicitly for a compound step.
q26 tagged compound_units: both tins are found through density, and the volume of the second is the difference the middle mark rewards.
q20 tagged angles_on_lines_and_circles then simplifying_ratio. Three of the five marks are angle chains through two isosceles triangles; the ratio in the form 1 : n is the last step.
q24a and q24b tagged plans_and_elevations, including the explanation of why a side elevation using the slant height is wrong.
